title: STILL-PRESENT: B1 renumber-hazard scenario unpinned — no test demolishes a preceding full bundle while the crisis's flaw survives
evidence: r2-mandate.md: "The resolve test must exercise the demolish-and-renumber scenario (not pass by fixture symmetry). B1 closed ONLY if the renumber-proof identity is real and pinned by a test that bites." / core/crisis_test.odin: "append(&s.action_log, Command{apply_tick = 1499, kind = Cmd_Demolish_Pipe{pipe = 0}})" and "append(&s.action_log, Command{apply_tick = 1499, kind = Cmd_Demolish_Pipe{pipe = 1}})" / core/crisis_test.odin fixture: "sla_draw(s, cat, r, g, \"narrow\", 1)" + "sla_draw(s, cat, g, h, \"narrow\", 1)" (only 2 bundles exist) / demos/surge.dem: "at 119000ms demolish pipe 0" + "at 119000ms demolish pipe 1" (both bundles die together; the only other demolish sites in the suite are @1600 pipe 5 and cooldown/clamptest copies @1499 pipes 0+1)
detail: Every crisis test demolishes the flaw's own bundle (a genuine resolve) or the fix; surge.dem kills both bundles at once. The mandate's hazard — a lower-slot full bundle demolished while the flaw stays saturated, renumbering the crisis's slot — never executes anywhere. The renumber-proof identity (crisis.odin:358 bundles_slot_for_pair re-resolution) is real code but is not pinned by a test that bites; all existing tests pass by fixture symmetry.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test: mid-crisis, demolish ONLY the lower-slot full bundle (e.g. pipe 0) while the flawed bundle stays saturated; assert no Crisis_Resolved, correct banner target, no same-tick re-trigger. Optionally mirror the scenario in a golden demo.
